# `Scanner/FatSuppress-v0` · Suppress the fat in each marked region and keep the water signal

**A · Signal and contrast** · selective signal · kind 2, set · isolates A18: Fat suppression by a frequency-selective saturation pulse. [The map](../../docs/tasks.md)

**Status:** ADMITTED: on 300 fresh instances per level the reference passes >= 98 %, no policy that ignores the object passes more than 6 % (95 % bounds)

The daily choice between spectral fat saturation and STIR. Fat saturation keeps the water signal but fails where the field is inhomogeneous, where the frequency adjustment is off and where the pulse is weak; STIR works everywhere but removes a large part of the water signal, and its inversion time depends on the T1 of that fat, on the repetition time and on how complete the inversion is. Neither can be looked up: fat saturation has to be tried on this object, and the null has to be measured. By level: level 1 is a measurement task, level 2 is a measurement task, level 3 is a measurement task (a fixed list of scans with a fixed estimator passes this many points below the reference: 0 at level 1, 0 at level 2, 0 at level 3; 300 instances per level; 25 points or more make a decision task).

Kind of task: **measurement** (reference minus open_loop, points of pass rate: 0 at level 1, 0 at level 2, 0 at level 3 (n = 300 per level, engine mrgym-engine-0.2.0)).

```python
import mrgym
env = mrgym.make("Scanner/FatSuppress-v0", level=2, seed=0)
obs, info = env.reset()
obs, reward, terminated, truncated, info = env.step({"name": "scanner_info", "arguments": {}})
```

| Given | Deliver | Scored by |
|---|---|---|
| A test object with several fat-containing vials (a different fat in each) in a strongly inhomogeneous field; the scanner; a scan-time budget for probing | For each marked region the method of its fat-suppressed spin-echo image: spectral fat saturation, or inversion recovery with the inversion time | Noise-free scans of the target image on the hidden object: every region must be suppressed by its method, and inversion recovery passes only where fat saturation is not enough |

## World

- On the table: QA phantom (a disc of gel with vials, four of them fat with their own T1), 3 T
- Sequences that matter here: se, ir, spgr
- Formulas the agent is given: S(TI) = a - b exp(-TI / T1) at a fixed repetition time; the sign of the signal is in the phase image; fat saturation acts where the fat resonance lies inside the pulse band

| Hidden (measurable only by scanning) | Told |
|---|---|
| T1 of the fat in every vial | the target scan and its repetition time |
| the off-resonance field and the error of the frequency adjustment | the regions, and that each contains fat |
| efficiency and bandwidth of the saturation pulse | both pass thresholds |
| inversion efficiency | the instrument datasheet |
| transmit gain and B1 pattern | realised protocol, timing and cost of every plan and scan |
| noise level |  |
| the 128-bit world seed |  |

## Levels

| Level | Covered by the claim | Hidden-world prior | Budget (s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | yes | an efficient saturation pulse and a nearly complete inversion: the field at a region decides whether fat saturation works there; the null follows from the fat's T1 and the repetition time | 120 |
| 2 | yes | the band of the saturation pulse is not the nominal one, which no field map shows: fat saturation has to be tried, not predicted | 120 |
| 3 | yes | as level 2 with an incomplete inversion, a miscalibrated transmitter and more noise: the null moves with the inversion efficiency | 120 |

## Deliverable and reward

- Deliverable: `submit` with `{'<region id>': {'method': 'fat_sat | stir', 'ti_ms': '<milliseconds, stir only>'}}`
- Reward range [0.0, 1.0]; paid only at submit; 0 on every other step
- Gates: the scanner log replays and is within budget; at least one accepted scan; the console accepts the target scan of every region
- Error: `largest over the regions of: signal in the target scan with the delivered method / signal without suppression (noise-free)`
- Score: `none: the reward is 1 for a pass and 0 otherwise`
- Passing: all gates and, for every region, error <= 5 %, and stir only where fat saturation leaves more than 3 %

# Suppress the fat in each marked region and keep the water signal
A test object with vials of unknown materials lies in the field of
view. Each marked region lies inside a vial that contains fat, a different fat in every vial. For each of them the
examination needs a spin-echo image in which the fat of that region is suppressed:
    tr_ms 2950, te_ms at the console minimum, matrix 128, bandwidth_hz_per_px 300, field of view at the
    console default, 1 average, slice 5 mm,
    either  sequence se with fat_sat true                (method fat_sat: spectral fat saturation)

  R2: y -13.64, x -55.19, radius 9

  R4: y -24.57, x 56.48, radius 9

Deliver one method per region (R1, R2, R3, R4, R5) with `submit`, and the inversion time where the method is stir. The target scans
are not run in this episode: the scanner evaluates what you deliver. Your own scans may use any sequence and any parameters the console accepts; only the deliverable is evaluated, on the scan the task names. That scan is not charged to the scan-time budget and not limited by it.
Nothing about the materials, the field or the state of the system is known in advance.

Passing, for every region:
1. Suppressed. In the target scan with the method you delivered for it, its signal is at most 5 % of its signal in

## Determinism and versions

same (seed, level, tool calls) -> same observations, log hash chain and reward; a repeated scan draws new noise; the verifier's scans are noise-free.

Rewards are comparable only within one environment version (the `-vN` suffix) and one scanner engine (`mrgym --version`).
